sections.title: Origin composition
sections.sql: select vineyard,vintage,variety,region,fraction from origins where lot_id=$1

sections.title: Operations
sections.sql: select name,kind,occurred_on,recorded_by,litres,from_vessel,to_vessel,note,evidence from operations where lot_id=$1 order by occurred_on,created_at

sections.title: Analysis
sections.sql: select sampled_on,metric,value,unit,lab_ref from analyses where lot_id=$1 order by sampled_on

sections.title: Supply particulars
sections.sql: select s.name,s.supplied_on,s.recorded_by,c.name as supplier,c.address as supplier_address,s.recipient,s.address as recipient_address,s.litres,l.name as lot,s.statement_ref,s.composition from supplies s join lots l on l.id=s.lot_id join clients c on c.id=l.client_id where s.id=$1
sections.note: Wine goods: bulk wine. Check composition and recipient details before signing or sharing.

sections.title: Packaging trace
sections.sql: select b.name,b.bottled_on,l.name as lot,b.bottles,b.bottle_ml,b.litres,b.packaging_ref,b.recorded_by from bottlings b join lots l on l.id=b.lot_id where b.id=$1

sections.title: Recorded job
sections.note: A work record, not an instruction to handle wine or chemicals without operator review.

sections.title: Exercise evidence
sections.sql: select r.name,r.performed_on,l.name as lot,r.reviewer,r.evidence,r.follow_up from recalls r join lots l on l.id=r.lot_id where r.id=$1
